welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: This is your first note. A quick tour of what's new, section by section.

style.heading: ✨ Style and structure your text
style.bold: **Bold**: add ** around the word to make it stand out more.
style.italic: *Italic*: add * around the word for a softer emphasis.
style.strike: ~~Strikethrough~~: add ~~ around the word to mark it as discarded.
style.code: `Code`: add ` around the word to show it in code format.
style.footer: **Would rather not type the symbols?** Use the icons in the bottom bar.

organize.quote: **Quote**: add > at the start of the line to highlight an important part.
organize.task: **To-do list**: add - [ ] at the start of the line to mark something pending.

table.bullet: **Table**: add | between each column to sort data into rows and columns.

organize.quote_example: This is what a highlighted quote looks like.
organize.task_example: Check this off once you're done

attachments.heading: 📎 Attach files
attachments.image: **Preview**: write `![[photo.png]]` to show a supported file right inside the note.
attachments.link: **Other files**: write `[[document.pdf]]` to get a chip that opens it in another app.
attachments.footer: Find every attached file in the **Files** view of the side menu.
